instruction: Write an XDP program that must evaluate destination addresses against LPM trie 'routing_trie_203' for gateway forwarding. On route hit, rewrite destination MAC to next-hop gateway and return XDP_TX; on route miss, return XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define LPM key struct with __u32 prefixlen and __u32 data members
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Perform bpf_map_lookup_elem on ip->daddr with prefixlen=32
On route match, update eth->h_dest with next-hop MAC and return XDP_TX
On route miss or non-IP, return XDP_PASS
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
